messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy 2026-03-17 21:12UTC - Canary group eu-west-1 for rollout r-2026.03.17 showing elevated error rate ~15% on /llm/generate. Dashboard: https://internal.infra/redwood/dash/rollouts/r-2026.03.17

alex (eng-oncall): seeing it, paging team. grabbing logs now.

maria (eng-sre): oncall here, pushing runbook. initial customer impact looks limited but measurable - some 5xx and retries. any idea traffic %?

sylvia (eng-runtime): canary weight is 5%. stack traces show OOM in model-worker during long sequences, batcher heap growth noted.

alex (eng-oncall): ok. recommendation: abort rollout and flip canary flag -> 0. agree?

ryan (product): are customers being paged/impacted beyond retries? SLAs?

maria (eng-sre): 34 distinct customers saw 1-3 failed requests each in the window. no widespread SLA breach yet but visible user errors. classify as partial degradation. mitigation recommended now.

alex (eng-oncall): mitigation plan: 1) flip feature flag canary.r-2026.03.17 -> false 2) drain canary nodes 3) manual rollback to r-2026.03.09 4) smoke tests + verify.

sylvia (eng-runtime): commands:
```bash
# flip canary
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ZZ\" https://flags.internal/flip -d '{\"flag\":\"canary.r-2026.03.17\",\"value\":false}'
# drain
infractl drain --cluster eu-west-1 --selector rollout=r-2026.03.17 --timeout 300
# rollback
deployctl promote --to-tag r-2026.03.09 --region eu-west-1
```

alex (eng-oncall): flipping flag now.

deploy-bot: feature flag flip requested by alex. executing.
deploy-bot: feature flag canary.r-2026.03.17 set to false -> ok.

maria (eng-sre): starting drain now.

sylvia (eng-runtime): drain progress: 3/4 workers drained, last one terminating.

alex (eng-oncall): initiating promote to r-2026.03.09 in eu-west-1 (low-traffic window).

deploy-bot: deploy started: promote r-2026.03.09 -> eu-west-1. task id d-7742.

maria (eng-sre): smoke tests queued:
- healthcheck /health
- small generate test prompt \"hello\"
- perf check p95 < 400ms

alex (eng-oncall): smoke passing on 2/3 nodes, one node shows previous OOM signature. re-run after drain complete.

sylvia (eng-runtime): logs show a memory spike at 21:14UTC then process restart on model-worker. looks like quantization path regression in v2. recommend block until patch.

ops-lead: I'll update status page and alert support with a brief summary and ETA.

maria (eng-sre): if drain completes and promote finishes cleanly, ETA ~12min for verification.

alex (eng-oncall): drain complete, promote finished. running final smoke.

deploy-bot: Deploy d-7742 -> success.

maria (eng-sre): all smoke tests green across canaries. p50/p95 stable, error rate back to baseline ~0.2%.

ryan (product): thanks team — any immediate follow-ups?

sylvia (eng-runtime): open a rollback postmortem. block reintroducing model v2 until we have memory guards. I'll create an internal ticket to add ephemeral memory limits and extra telemetry for batcher growth.

alex (eng-oncall): handing off to maria for post-incident follow-ups. I'll be available if anything regresses.
maria (eng-sre): acknowledged. updating incident channel and marking rollout incident resolved. adding notes to the rollout record.

deploy-bot: Incident note appended to rollout r-2026.03.17: manual rollback executed; suspected cause: OOM in quantized execution path.

alex (eng-oncall): :thumbsup: closing thread unless anyone needs more.

maria (eng-sre): closing timeline — will post a short postmortem with next actions and owner assignments.
